messages:
elena: Heads-up: we're sunsetting the SDK config flag `enable_legacy_retry`. Docs updated and SDK v4.2 will remove the flag. Migration guide and compatibility shim linked below. TL;DR: switch to the new `retry.policy` block and test against the canary before upgrade.

ashok: Quick q — what scenarios require the shim vs immediate code changes? is it safe for prod?

elena: Good Q. Shim is safe but intended short-term only. It translates the old boolean into the new structured policy at runtime; it adds ~1-2ms overhead per call. Use it if you can't ship the code path change before the SDK upgrade. We're planning a 90-day coexistence window.

marc: Can we get a sample migration snippet for server-side config?

elena: Yep — adding here.

```json
# old
{
  "enable_legacy_retry": true
}
# new
{
  "retry": {
    "strategy": "exponential",
    "max_retries": 3,
    "backoff_ms": 200
  }
}
```

elena: And env for shim if needed: `REDWOOD_SDK_COMPAT_SHIM=enable_legacy_retry`

jen: Plan for customer comms? we should notify enterprise customers with Dedicated/Private early.

elena: Yes — outreach staged: docs + changelog today, targeted email to Dedicated/Private in 48h, release notes in product changelog when v4.2 ships. We will include migration checklist and a small test harness.

docs-bot: Docs published: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/sdk/migration/enable_legacy_retry-sunset (summary + CLI test harness). Updated the SDK changelog entry.

ashok: For rolling upgrades — suggest we gate by canary group: 5% of traffic for 48h, then 25% for 24h, then full. Add metrics to monitor: retry-rate, 5xx-rate, p99-latency.

marc: Agree. Also will add an automated lint rule that fails CI if `enable_legacy_retry` is present in repo config after 2025-07-01.

elena: Ops plan: schedule SDK v4.2 cut next Tuesday; release train will include canary rollout and a post-deploy sweep runbook (who to page if high 5xx). Ping @eng if you want the runbook slot.

jen: :thumbsup: thanks — will draft the customer email and a short blurb for the public changelog.

ashok: noted. I'll add telemetry events for shim usage so we can measure how many customers rely on it.

elena: Thanks all — please file any migration blockers in #docs-migration and tag me. Closing thread after the changelog post.
